messages.content: Independent enterprise rubric for exact predeployment SHA fa4ba23f5a764e5079569b470455183ba77695d8. P if evidence is sufficient and no concrete material defect exists. Navigation/UI-only changes are acceptable. Deployment proof is not required until the release node. Emit schema JSON only.

WEB021 changes QuickCreate, Studio navigation, CSS and E2E acceptance only. Single-brand users get direct creation actions; multi-brand users retain verified accessible submenu behavior. Primary sidebar is reduced to Inicio/Crear/Revisar/Entregas; brand setup stays reachable in one disclosure. Liquid-glass material adds layered transparency, blur, saturation, rim/highlight/refraction and reduced-motion fallback. No auth, server persistence, provider, dependency, Docker, Compose, deployment control plane or trust roots changed. Exact clean verification: typecheck/build PASS, 13 contracts PASS, prod audit clean, browser E2E PASS with one-brand direct menu, multi-brand keyboard/Escape/safe-pointer/touch, mobile no overflow/no browser errors, non-test FIRMES completion PASS, full suite 156/155 PASS/0 FAIL/1 pre-existing SKIP.
